description:
Cut the CLI re-proofs of dependency auto-transitions to one wiring case.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/workflow_tests.rs` re-proves dependency auto-transitions in four subprocess tests (`:529`, `:577`, `:646`, `:698`). A pure domain function owns the rules, with unit and property tests.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `workflow_tests.rs` holds one auto-transition case, which shows that completing a dependency through the CLI readies its dependent; the other three cases no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each removed case's rule has an owning test of the domain function before the case is removed, so no semantic case remains here; the domain owners are added ahead of this change, which adds none itself.
title: Workflow CLI tests keep one auto-transition wiring case
